premise: The flower's water tank is nearly empty, so the excavator fetches a chunk of crater ice, and the melted ice fills it up.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Crow and the Pitcher', where a thirsty crow cleverly raises the water with pebbles, turned: the clever way to water a flower on the Moon is to fetch ice.
lesson: Help can come from the most unlikely helper.

en-US.title: Ice for the Flower
en-US.text: In its sealed box, the orange {flower:enter} flower had a little water tank. And the tank was nearly empty. {flower:shake 0.3} [nervously] The flower needed a drink. But on the Moon, you can't just turn on a tap. So the {excavator:enter} excavator trundled off {excavator:go to crater} to the crater, where the sunlight never reaches. [curious] There, frozen into the dust, waited a chunk of {ice:enter} ice, as cold as cold can be. {ice:live} Frost spread over it and sparkled. {excavator:pulse} {excavator:live} Scoop! {sfx:scoop} Up came the ice, dust and all. {excavator:go to flower} Back trundled the excavator, careful not to drop a crumb. Into the melter went the ice. {sfx:drip} Drip. Drip. Drip. {flower:spray 0.4} [happily] {flower:live} The tank filled up, and the flower turned its bloom up toward its lamp, bright as ever. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Everyone came to see. {excavator:sparkle} [warmly] And the excavator was very proud of its delivery: one scoop, carefully.

es-ES.title: Hielo para la flor
es-ES.text: En su caja sellada, la {flower:enter} flor naranja tenía un pequeño depósito de agua. Y el depósito estaba casi vacío. {flower:shake 0.3} [nervously] La flor necesitaba beber. Pero en la Luna no basta con abrir un grifo. Así que la {excavator:enter} excavadora se fue traqueteando {excavator:go to crater} hasta el cráter, donde nunca llega el sol. [curious] Allí, congelado en el polvo, esperaba un trozo de {ice:enter} hielo, más frío que el frío. {ice:live} La escarcha lo cubrió y brilló. {excavator:pulse} {excavator:live} ¡Palada! {sfx:scoop} Arriba fue el hielo, con polvo y todo. {excavator:go to flower} La excavadora volvió traqueteando, con cuidado de no perder ni una miga. El hielo entró en el derretidor. {sfx:drip} Gota. Gota. Gota. {flower:spray 0.4} [happily] {flower:live} El depósito se llenó, y la flor giró hacia su lámpara, tan brillante como siempre. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Todos fueron a verla. {excavator:sparkle} [warmly] Y la excavadora estaba muy orgullosa de su entrega: una palada, con mucho cuidado.

scoop.prompt: a machine scooping up a chunk of ice and gritty soil, a crunchy scrape

drip.prompt: three slow gentle water drips falling into a small metal tank
